_comment: LLM Analyzer Configuration - Copy to llm_config.json and adjust values
_enabled_info: Master switch to enable/disable LLM analysis. Set to false to disable without removing config.
_provider_info: LLM provider: 'anthropic' (Claude) or 'openai' (GPT). Requires corresponding API key.
_model_info: Model identifier. Examples: claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929, claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022, gpt-4-turbo, gpt-3.5-turbo
_api_key_env_info: Environment variable name containing the API key. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY in .env file.
_trigger_on_window_info: Which observation window (in minutes) triggers LLM analysis. Typical values: 10, 30, 60. Set to 10 for most granular (critical) alerts.
_max_tokens_response_info: Maximum tokens in LLM response. Higher = more detailed analysis but higher cost. Range: 500-4000.
_timeout_seconds_info: API call timeout in seconds. Increase if getting timeout errors. Range: 10-60.
_temperature_info: LLM temperature (creativity). Lower = more consistent. For security analysis, keep between 0.0-0.3.

rate_limit._max_calls_per_hour_info: Maximum LLM API calls per hour. Prevents cost runaway. Adjust based on alert volume and budget.
rate_limit._max_calls_per_day_info: Maximum LLM API calls per day. Hard limit for budget control.

retry._max_retries_info: Number of retry attempts on transient failures (rate limits, timeouts). Range: 1-5.
retry._backoff_seconds_info: Base seconds for exponential backoff. Retry delays: backoff^attempt (e.g., 2s, 4s, 8s). Range: 1-5.
